results.name: Adjustable Glass Dashboard
results.description: A responsive glass workspace with adjustable blur, opacity, saturation, tint and edge lighting. Data-driven dashboard views include searchable activity, savings goals, reports and CSV export, with GSAP transitions and host-theme support.
results.author: automate_flows

results.name: Interactive Workflow Blueprint
results.description: An interactive workflow canvas for showcasing and planning automations. Add and edit agents, drag steps, connect actions, undo changes, and export the example as JSON.
results.author: automate_flows

results.name: Glassy Coverflow Carousel
results.description: A responsive 3D coverflow carousel for poster galleries and media collections. Includes swipe and keyboard navigation, optional autoplay, light and dark themes, reduced-motion support, and an on-demand trailer dialog. Media and branding are supplied through props.
results.author: automate_flows

results.name: Dimensional Workflow Hero
results.description: A responsive GSAP hero with a fanned 3D deck, scroll-driven workflow chapters and custom React scenes. Includes phone layouts, chapter navigation, semantic light and dark themes, and a reduced-motion reading layout. Copy and visuals are supplied through props.
results.author: automate_flows
